question_text: State two advantages of a balanced BST over an unsorted fixed-capacity array for a changing collection of uniquely keyed records.
adaptation_rationale: Restricts source generic binary tree to a balanced BST and states the array is unsorted; avoids false claims that all binary trees guarantee efficient searching.
solution: A balanced BST supports logarithmic key-search paths rather than an unsorted linear scan. Nodes can be added without choosing one fixed array capacity in advance.

marking_points.criterion: Dynamic node growth rather than fixed capacity.
